gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk leaves its bowls unfinished on one side, which gives the text a lively, slightly open feel. And Tilt Neon bends glass-tube letters at constant width with a big x-height, loud where the body is quick.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-nunito: Unica One draws every curve like a technical pen, with daylight inside each bend. It commands attention up top, while Nunito rounds off its terminals and fills big soft bowls to keep the text friendly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-quicksand: Stencil-cut and bold, Wallpoet leaves gaps where the paper shows through between its high-rising letters. But Quicksand is the surprise: its tall bowls look like blown glass bulbs, drawn with a rhythm of identical bar thickness.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Warnes tapers its ink strokes to nothing before they touch, with no thick-thin contrast and stretched tracking. And Pilcrow Rounded packs its letters tight, with big counters, so the two feel like opposite ends of one idea.
gen-luckiest-guy-fs-merriweather-sans: Luckiest Guy shouts in poured ink at one width, with a mean line set high and cheerful swagger. Merriweather Sans answers by making words look sturdy and large.
gen-megrim-fs-familjen-grotesk: Angular and futuristic, Megrim keeps its arms and legs at a measured thickness. Its heading draws a skyward x-height line, whereas Familjen Grotesk leaves bowls unfinished on one side for a livelier, quicker body.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-nunito: Nunito rounds off its terminals clear of the stem and lets its big bowls roll out softly across the line. Press Start 2P brings the retro fun, pinned far apart like cut-out letters.
gen-syne-gf-montagu-slab: Syne runs experimental, with plain constant ink and an x-height near cap height. Montagu Slab follows in a text serif, its robust downstrokes and slender turns reading comfortably on screen over many lines.
gen-almendra-display-rubik: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never pinches its letters shut, and its x-height is pronounced. Rubik takes the other job, with soft open rounds that stay clear at small sizes.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-kay-pho-du: Kay Pho Du has counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open, with a traditional text serif feel. But Chubbo is the casual one, drawing each smooth bend as if with a marker tip.
